title: Proscription Litigation
summary: The challenge to Palestine Action’s proscription and the litigation sources collected in July 2026.
review_note: The litigation narrative and citation below are retained from the July dossier, not independently confirmed as the current position. Check the judgments, any stay, subsequent appeals and the current official proscription list before relying on its status.
body_html:
Palestine Action proscribed under the Terrorism Act 2000 in July 2025 — the first such designation for a direct-action protest group. Huda Ammori’s challenge succeeded at the High Court in February 2026 and was reversed by the Court of Appeal in June 2026. Home Secretary v Ammori [2026] EWCA Civ 1721

  • Palestine Action terror ban ruled unlawful by High Court in humiliating blow for government The Independent · 13 February 2026 aol.com/news/palestine-action-terror-ban-ruled-101433277.html Source for the key statistic: more than 2,000 arrested for holding signs, nearly 700 charged with a terrorism offence, none convicted. Home Office legal spend approaching £700,000.
  • Britain’s High Court says government illegally banned pro-Palestinian group NPR · 13 February 2026 npr.org/2026/02/13/nx-s1-5713346/britain-court-palestine-action-ban
  • Palestine Action cofounder Ammori after High Court win: UK ban ‘backfired’ Al Jazeera · 13 February 2026 aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/13/palestine-action-cofounder-ammori-after-high-court-win-uk-ban-backfired
  • Home Office allowed to appeal Palestine Action court ruling BBC aol.com/articles/home-office-allowed-appeal-palestine-182155879.html
  • UK Court of Appeal upholds ban on Palestine Action as ‘terrorist’ group Al Jazeera · 15 June 2026 aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/15/uk-court-says-proscribing-palestine-action-as-terrorist-group-was-lawful The reversal. Do not publish anything that omits this.

The most rigorous account of the reasoning.
